text:
Zoe: Tiny game: reply with a two-word compliment for the person to your left (IRL or Slack). I'll go: Mug whisperer.

Miguel: Keyboard poet.

Hana: Plant lawyer. (that one is for Zoe)

Omar: Lunch magician.

Jules: Sticky-note ninja.

snackbot: :confetti_ball: Bonus round unlocked: whoever brings donuts on Friday gets a custom emoji.

Zoe: Also quick logistics: new fridge rule 1 no unlabeled tupperware after 2pm. who knew science would be needed.

Miguel: not me, I volunteer as tribute. label system: name + date or it goes to communal mystery bin.

Hana: suggestion: leave tiny ransom note instead of name. more dramatic. :laughing:

Omar: vote: communal mystery bin -> compost? yes/no?

Jules: yes to compost, unless it's actually a sandwich. then labelling applies.

Zoe: tiny poll result: compost wins. Hana, start the ransom-note experiment next week.

Miguel: quick kudos: shoutout to Jules for rescuing my laptop charger on Tuesday. champion behavior. :trophy:

Jules: low-key heroism. charger retrieval is an extreme sport.

Hana: one-liner time: "If coffee could talk, it would likely plead for mercy."

Omar: my one-liner: "Office plant attendance meeting scheduled for 3pm."

Zoe: closing note: if you see an unlabeled Tupperware, please leave a haiku on it. rules: 5-7-5, no pressure.

snackbot: :sparkles: Haiku enforcement robot pending deployment.

Miguel: thread concluded. emojis and micro-games forever. :raised_hands:
